text: I continued to operate my phone, then looked up at the people around me. At that moment, Jake stood up and said, "Okay, then I have one more thing." He added, "Let's see if we can squeeze it in." I turned my head to look at him as he continued, "Yes, let's squeeze it in." The table was filled with various items, including boxes and tools, while a few people were sitting around, focused on their tasks.

I saw Jake standing up and gesturing with his hands, seemingly explaining something. He said, 'Let's try it out, everyone try it out.' I looked at the items on the table, which included some boxes and tools, and then turned to look at Lucia. She was focused on her phone, and I noticed she was wearing glasses. Jake continued, 'Let's go through it again.' I picked up my phone and handed it to Lucia, who took it and started operating it. I watched as she opened an app and then closed it. Jake said, 'Alright, open it.' Lucia nodded and replied, 'Yes.' I glanced around the room, noticing a few people sitting around the table, which was covered with various items, including some boxes and tools. The room had a whiteboard on one wall and a projector screen on another. I turned back to Lucia and continued watching her operate the phone. Jake added, 'Then we'll talk about what we did today.' Lucia looked up from her phone and said, 'Then we can do something.' I nodded in agreement, thinking about how we could spend the rest of the day.

I saw Jake standing up, gesturing with his hands as he spoke. He mentioned that there were four more USBs and asked what to call the hard drive. I noticed Lucia was focused on her phone, while Tasha was looking at the documents in front of her. Jake continued explaining that in the morning, everyone would mainly discuss, and during discussions, they could use the hard drive to share files. He suggested using it to avoid getting lost in the chaos. I glanced around the room, where a few people were busy working, and the table was filled with various equipment and documents. Jake then said, "Let's start baking now." I looked at him as he walked over to the table, and Lucia chimed in, "Let's check the recipe first." Jake nodded and added, "Yeah, let's check the recipe first." The room was brightly lit, with a whiteboard and some decorations on the walls.

I opened the box and took out a screw, then placed it on the table. I heard Jake say, "Hey, only four left." Lucia responded, "Yeah, only four left." I reassured her, "It's okay, I've already checked one." Jake added, "Because you're the manager." I nodded in agreement, "Oh, right." Then I said, "I've already installed this." I continued to take out screws from the box, placing them on the table. The table was filled with various tools and parts, and everyone was busy working. I noticed there were still some screws left in the box, so I picked them up and placed them on the table as well.

I continued to take out the items from the box, placing them on the table. The table was filled with various tools and parts, and I carefully organized each piece. Nearby, a few people were busy working, with one person in blue standing by, seemingly observing our progress. I picked up a black object and placed it on the table, then turned around to look at everyone. At that moment, Jake asked, "What's this?" and Tasha replied, "It's a screw." I noticed Lucia was focused on her work, and Jake mentioned, "The screw is here." I adjusted my glasses and continued to organize the items on the table, ensuring everything was in order.

I continued to hold the bag, and Lucia asked me if I had taken out all the items. I nodded in agreement, and she said, "Alright, everyone take out what you need." I placed the bag on the table and picked up a screwdriver, then handed it to Jake. He took the screwdriver and started working on the hard drive. I watched as he carefully unscrewed the cover of the hard drive, revealing its internal components. The table was filled with various tools and parts, and there were several boxes and documents scattered around.

They explained that this part could be demonstrated, and I saw them pointing at a specific area on the hard drive. I adjusted my glasses and continued focusing on the task at hand, ensuring everything was correctly assembled.

The table was filled with various items, including documents and electronic devices. I walked towards the kitchen, passing by a person in blue clothes who was standing by the window. The kitchen had a sink and some utensils on the counter. I continued walking forward, passing by a person in green clothes, and then turned right to walk into another room. In this room, there were several people standing around a table with computers and other equipment. One person was wearing a blue shirt and seemed to be explaining something to the others. I walked over to them and asked, "Is this your workspace?" They replied, "Yes." I continued, "Then this part has six computers, right?" They nodded and said, "Seven, eight, nine." I smiled and added, "Then there are seven, eight, and nine."

He pointed at the computer and continued, saying that each computer would be used for three hours after recording, and then the data would be transferred to the hard drive. He added that this hard drive was where we would store the data, like the L1, L2, and L3, with names written on them. I listened attentively as he explained how the data would be stored and managed.

I saw him gesturing with his hands as he explained. Lucia stood next to me, listening attentively. I looked around the room, noticing the bed and some scattered items on the table. Jake continued, 'And then you can use this to test the hard drive.' I nodded, understanding what he was saying.

Lucia mentioned, "You need four screws, uh, eight screws." I kept working on the hard drive, making sure all parts were firmly attached.

I glanced at the hard drive, making sure everything was in order, and then turned to look at Jake, who was still talking about the free upgrade.
